parole.significato: goulash (stew of beef or veal and vegetables, flavoured with paprika)
parole.testo: Likely borrowed from Austrian German Gulasch, Golasch, from Hungarian gulyás.

parole.significato: matura (exam taken at age 18/19 to graduate from secondary education)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Austrian German Matura, from Latin matura (“mature”).
Possibly borrowed from Austrian German Soletti, a genericized trademark. By surface analysis, сол (sol, “salt”) + -ета (-eta).
